title: UzPainter public golden manifest
description: A public parity manifest (parity/manifests/**/*.json; parity/CONTRACT.md §6). It holds only independently authored inputs, UzmiGames instruction sequences, the settings a test applies, public-documentation-derived expectations, software identities and the SHA-256 of every private oracle record. It never holds a recorded Painter output: every object is closed (additionalProperties false) and no field can carry a recorded value.

domain.description: Comparison domain the golden belongs to (the key exception entries match on).

applied_settings.description: Settings the test applies (recorder by API, or the operator from the settings sheet). Values are authored by UzmiGames, never read back from Painter.

uncontrolled_settings.description: Names of settings the Phase 0 probe found cannot be fixed or read (07-preview-and-render-parity.md §2.1). Names only, never values.

private_records.description: SHA-256 of every private oracle record of this golden (empty until `uzpainter parity record` writes them).

scalar.description: A short authored value. Strings are bounded so that no slot can carry a recorded blob or a serialized readback.

public_source_id.description: An approved public source of docs/approved-sources.md (specifications, papers, platform documentation, public Adobe documentation). Black-box observation (A-OBSERVE) is private and never a public derivation.

kind.description: recipe_json is a UzmiGames-authored recipe only; a recipe dumped or extracted from a Painter project is a private record, never a public input. pipeline_script is a UzmiGames pipeline script run byte-unchanged under the uzmigames_pipeline_scripts interface. painter_project is a UzmiGames project file saved by Painter, named by SHA-256 only and never read by UzPainter: the recorder opens a hash-checked private copy in Painter under the painter_project_migration interface (decision 194).

assets3d_path.description: Location, relative to the UzmiGames asset repository (Assets3D), of an input kept outside this repository: named here by SHA-256 only, never distributed; the recorder resolves it under the Assets3D root it is given and refuses a hash mismatch (decision 099).

licence.description: LicenseRef-UzmiGames-Assets3D: a UzmiGames asset of the Assets3D repository, never distributed with UzPainter (only with assets3d_path, never with path).

interface.description: Painter's documented Python API (A-PYDOC): each step is one documented substance_painter call; or UzmiGames pipeline scripts run byte-unchanged, pinned by SHA-256, through Painter's documented remote control: each step is one script run (call uzmigames.pipeline.run_script); the scripts are UzmiGames code calling Painter's public Python API, pinned rather than checked symbol by symbol (a Tier 1 rebuild, decision 099). The community MCP bridge is never an interface. painter_project_migration: a UzmiGames project saved by Painter (a painter_project input) is opened from a private copy and exported through the documented API, its state read back privately (a Tier 1 migration golden, decision 194).

call.description: A documented symbol, e.g. substance_painter.export.export_project_textures; under the uzmigames_pipeline_scripts interface, uzmigames.pipeline.run_script.

args.description: Authored arguments: short scalars or short lists of scalars (inputs are referenced by input_id). No nested objects.

locator.description: Where in the public source the expectation is stated (section, page, symbol).

version.description: Painter version of the envelope the golden was recorded under (decision 037: the acceptance oracle is the current envelope; the version is no longer pinned).

uzpainter_build_hash.description: Build hash of the UzPainter build compared against this golden; null for a golden recorded before any comparison.

kind.description: oracle_environment_record: the environment record a golden was recorded under (decision 034 (a)); its SHA-256 is the public hash of the record, whose fields stay private.

not_migratable.description: A fixture that cannot be rebuilt through documented APIs (CONTRACT.md §6). Its gate stays blocked unless owner_scope_decision names a recorded owner decision.
